decision: A closed cubic sci-fi cargo box for provisional non-colliding decoration, viewed at player height from all sides. The supplied BlackBox.png is the design reference and the user-selected TRELLIS GLB is 3D reference. A 9,000-triangle reduction shredded the panels, so the delivery is a clean hard-surface rebuild with paired doors, service latch, armored corners, silver trim and corner reflectors. The user requested a shiny finish: dark graphite metal with low roughness and polished chrome trim is authored in the color and metallic-roughness atlases. Approximate 4.45-stud height and decoration role await visual approval.
